kvass: A fermented cereal-based low alcoholic beverage, often flavored with fruit, honey and herbs.
kvetch: To whine or complain, often needlessly and incessantly.
kvetched: simple past and past participle of kvetch
kvetchier: comparative form of kvetchy: more kvetchy
kvetchiest: superlative form of kvetchy: most kvetchy
kvetching: present participle and gerund of kvetch
